title: Quel’Delar: The Broken Blade Restored
summary: A battered hilt leads into the sister blade’s contested history, its reforging in Icecrown, purification at the Sunwell, and distinct faction and class endings.
opening: The Wrath questline begins with a blade already broken. The seeker’s identity, faction, and eventual reward branch vary; the story follows that shared search without inventing a canonical player.

chapters.title: The battered hilt
chapters.body: A randomized quest item opens one faction-specific road to Quel’Delar’s Rest and the dragon record.

chapters.title: A blade remembered
chapters.body: Dragon counsel and a returned record lead backward to Anasterian, Thalorien and Lana’thel’s destruction of the blade.

chapters.title: Make the blade whole
chapters.body: The chosen faction promises restoration; saronite reforging and soul-forge tempering lead to the Halls of Reflection.

chapters.title: Light and inheritance
chapters.body: The story distinguishes Thalorien’s old death from a later trial, purifies Quel’Delar and resolves into mutually exclusive rewards.

reviewNote: Research story with secondary quest transcripts and a secondary mirror of an archived Blizzard article. Original Wrath 3.3.5a quest text, relative flashback dates, and faction variants need client comparison and editor review. Randomized loot is a gameplay trigger; Alliance and Horde lines are alternatives; Thalorien’s historical death is distinct from his later quest test; no named adventurer is canonical. Generated art is interpretive; in-client area/model resemblance review remains open.
